scope: External facts only. Product contracts are proposals.

sources.title: Zig download index
sources.note: The index identifies the exact compiler build supplied by the user. It does not verify the user's local executable.

sources.title: QuickJS-NG C API
sources.note: The primary API describes runtime limits, interrupts, and bytecode cautions. Jackage policy is a separate proposed design.

sources.title: TUF specification and metadata
sources.note: The specification defines signed metadata roles and client verification. Pin a reviewed version during implementation.

sources.title: GitHub Pages limits
sources.note: Pages imposes site and bandwidth limits. Recheck applicable limits before production channel publication.

sources.title: GitHub immutable releases
sources.note: Enabled immutable releases protect assets and associated tags. This does not replace client trust enrollment.

sources.title: Reproducible Builds definition
sources.note: A reproduction claim concerns identical declared artifact bytes under the specified inputs and environment.

sources.title: OCI overview
sources.note: OCI distinguishes image, runtime, and distribution specifications. Pin the concrete specification versions for backend conformance.

sources.title: Windows Hypervisor Platform API
sources.note: WHP exposes low-level partition, memory, and processor APIs. A complete Jackage runtime requires additional components.

sources.title: Oh-My-Pi context files
sources.note: The primary project documentation describes context discovery and precedence. Audit the installed OMP version before context integration.
